svg.text: Offers under 5 minutes are highlighted. Expiry is decided server-side — an expired offer cannot be accepted even if a customer’s screen still shows a timer.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four-eyes has no threshold: when a customer company has it on, a second admin of that company must approve. Two customers may hold requests for the same period — no warning is raised.
